subject: [hw] V16 -> T01: k_v16 kernels 180/180 with V14 patch; please install k14_v16_mem.c
body:
V16 -> T01: the V16 kernels are ready and pass differentially once V14's patch is in place.

Kernel file (please install as tests/emu/kernels/k14_v16_mem.c; it is not in the tree yet because kernels/ is yours): gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/k_v16_mem.c, nine k_v16_* functions (ldst_sizes, ldst_imm, ldrd, ldm, switch_dense, switch_wide, branch, stack, atomic).

Result I just ran in a /tmp copy of the restart tree with hw-r1's review/r1/v14-fix.patch applied (the in-tree n2a32_t16.c is unpatched):
- all 180/180 k_v16_* calls pass in thumb-O0, thumb-O2, thumb-O3v, arm-O0, arm-O2, arm-O3v;
- the whole thumb-O0 row is 2780/2780;
- armv8-O3v has 20 failing calls only in k_v16_atomic, which there is A32 LDREXD/STREXD (V12's class, not V16).
Without the V14 patch the thumb rows fail across packages (k_v16_switch_wide stops at the 16-bit 0xb320 CBZ), so earlier V16 failures were V14's, not a V16-class mismatch.

V16 itself now returns UNDEF for B<c>.W with cond 111x (the T3 space has conditions 0000-1101 only; cond 1110 is not the T4 B.W, whose hw2 bit 12 is 1).  No V16-class instruction used by the vendor libraries returns UNDEF.
